data.headline: Careers at StimuliiQ
data.subheadline: Help us build the future of medical training in India. We are a remote-friendly team.

items.title: Senior Clinical Research Instructor
items.description: Lead live and recorded clinical research training for cohorts of 20 to 30 students. 3+ years of hospital or industry research experience required.

items.title: Career Counsellor
items.description: Guide medical students through program selection and placement preparation. Strong communication skills and a healthcare or edtech background preferred.

items.title: Full Stack Engineer (NestJS + Next.js)
items.description: Build and maintain our LMS, CRM, and marketing platforms. 2+ years with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
